commands.purpose: Verify all required packages from an empty cwd under task-test isolation
argv:
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import site
import sys
import pytest
import numpy
import PIL
assert site.ENABLE_USER_SITE is False
assert 'PYTHONPATH' not in os.environ
assert 'PYTHONHOME' not in os.environ
assert not list(Path.cwd().iterdir())
assert Path(pytest.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix).resolve())
print(json.dumps({
    'python': sys.executable,
    'python_version': sys.version,
    'prefix': sys.prefix,
    'base_prefix': sys.base_prefix,
    'user_site_enabled': site.ENABLE_USER_SITE,
    'cwd_was_empty': True,
    'pytest': {'version': pytest.__version__, 'file': pytest.__file__},
    'numpy': {'version': numpy.__version__, 'file': numpy.__file__},
    'PIL': {'version': PIL.__version__, 'file': PIL.__file__},
    'dependencies': {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in ('pytest', 'numpy', 'Pillow', 'iniconfig', 'packaging', 'pluggy', 'pygments')}
}, indent=2))
